name: BakuganDB
author: AfterWorld
description: Searchable fan game card, gate, fusion and Bakugan reference with explicit source completeness indicators.
install_msg: Load with [p]load bakugandb. Try [p]bcard blue squall, [p]bcards aquos, [p]bfusion blue stealth, and [p]bbakugan preyas.
end_user_data_statement: Stores optional Discord user ID to public Bakugan Brawl profile ID links and bot-wide public deck post IDs, titles, channel/message IDs, author IDs, website deck exports when provided, and copies of shared deck images in the cog data directory. Users can unlink profiles and remove deck listings; Red user deletion clears listings and cached images. Original shared Discord messages remain until separately deleted.
